THE INVESTMENT CASE

A specific operational problem.
A wider infrastructure ambition.

The problem we are starting with.

Policy changes, premium adjustments and carrier reports often live in separate files. Each handover creates work to establish which version applies, how an amount was derived and what the carrier should receive.

The product we are building.

Bordeon connects that history at transaction level. We are starting with one binder’s path from accepted business to reporting, then extending the same model through reusable carrier templates and connections to finance.

The commercial model we intend to validate.

Paid, scoped pilots followed by recurring software subscriptions. Expansion comes from additional binders, reporting relationships and workflows within the same customer. Pricing and onboarding effort will be tested with pilot customers.

The experience behind the company.

Our founding team brings Nordic insurance experience, including work on the carrier side and with the underlying insurance information. We are turning that experience into a product for the teams responsible for policy changes, premium records and reporting.

WHAT THE CAPITAL IS INTENDED TO BUILD

From a working prototype
to repeatable customer delivery.

The €1M funding objective supports three priorities. The detailed budget, delivery plan and financing terms are topics for investor discussions.

01 / PRODUCT

A product ready for customer operations.

Develop production readiness, Excel intake, validation, carrier-specific reporting templates and traceable exception handling around the demonstrated transaction model.

02 / CUSTOMER EVIDENCE

Paid pilots with measurable outcomes.

Validate the workflow with specialty MGAs. Measure reporting effort, corrections, acceptance of the output and willingness to continue on a paid subscription.

03 / REPEATABLE DELIVERY

A clear route to the first ten customers.

Build reusable configurations, a documented onboarding process and a focused sales approach. Expand through additional binders and carrier relationships.

CURRENT POSITION

A demonstrable workflow.
Clear next milestones.

What can be demonstrated today.

The browser-based proof of concept connects manual intake, policy versions, premium adjustments, two-carrier allocation, CSV bordereaux and settlement obligation snapshots using synthetic data.

Explore the working prototype ↗

What comes next.

Production readiness and the scoped pilot capabilities are the next delivery milestones. Customer outcomes, recurring revenue and the effort required to onboard each new binder will be measured through those pilots.
